    1  """Independent H_cons saved-result audit. Linux py310 only; no labels/models/Memory.
    2  Adapted from the closed H audit for H_cons two endpoints, 52 saved S/H inputs,
    3  registered comparisons and corrected per-metric forgetting direction.
    4  No production finalize/blind_gate is invoked; no new statistical choices.
    5  """
    6  import argparse
    7  import csv
    8  import hashlib
    9  import json
   10  import platform
   11  import time
   12  from datetime import datetime
   13  from pathlib import Path
   14  
   15  import numpy as np
   16  
   17  
   18  def read(path):
   19      return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   20  
   21  
   22  def write(path, value):
   23      path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
   24  
   25  
   26  def main():
   27      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   28      parser.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path, required=True)
   29      parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
   30      args = parser.parse_args()
   31      started = time.perf_counter()
   32      args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
   33      root = args.workspace / "reports/job"
   34      run, evaluation = root / "run", root / "evaluation"
   35      manifest, completion = read(run / "manifest.json"), read(root / "completion.json")
   36      col, reported = read(evaluation / "collected.json"), read(evaluation / "evaluation.json")
   37      before, access, execution = (read(root / n) for n in ("before_valid.json", "access.json", "execution.json"))
   38      assert before["status"] == "ALL_BLIND_GATES_PASS"
   39      assert before["access"] == dict(train=1, valid=0, heldout=0, owners=0)
   40      assert access == completion["access"] == dict(train=1, valid=1, heldout=0, owners=0)
   41      assert completion["physical_updates"] == manifest["physical_updates"] == 576
   42      assert completion["gradient_group_presentations"] == manifest["gradient_group_presentations"] == 864
   43      assert not (root / "failure.json").exists()
   44      gate = read(args.workspace / execution["gate"]["path"])
   45      policy = read(args.workspace / "schema/step28_h_consistency_policy.json")
   46      sources = completion["source_files"]
   47      assert len(sources) == 44
   48      for obj in (manifest, col, reported, before, gate):
   49          assert obj["source_files"] == sources
   50      assert execution["sources"] == sources
   51      checked_files = []
   52  
   53      def verify(parent, rec):
   54          p = parent / rec["path"]
   55          assert p.stat().st_size == rec["bytes"]
   56          assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == rec["sha256"]
   57          checked_files.append(str(p.relative_to(args.workspace)))
   58          return p
   59  
   60      for r in sources:
   61          verify(args.workspace, r)
   62          verify(run / "sources", r)
   63      verify(root, before["manifest"])
   64      baseline = read(args.workspace / "reports/documentation/20261016/h_consistency/baseline_sources.json")
   65      assert len(baseline["files"]) == 52
   66      for r in baseline["files"] + baseline["unchanged_direct_sources"]:
   67          verify(args.workspace, r)
   68      old_runs = {}
   69      for info in baseline["baselines"].values():
   70          old_root = args.workspace / info["root"]
   71          old_col = read(old_root / "evaluation/collected.json")
   72          old_manifest = read(old_root / "run/manifest.json")
   73          assert col["group_ids"] == old_col["group_ids"] and col["domains"] == old_col["domains"] and col["columns"] == old_col["columns"]
   74          assert manifest["public_inputs"] == old_manifest["public_inputs"]
   75          assert read(run / "partition.json") == read(old_root / "run/partition.json")
   76          assert old_manifest["initials"][info["arm"]] == info["initial_identity"] == manifest["initials"]["H_cons"]
   77          old_runs[info["arm"]] = (old_root, old_col, old_manifest)
   78      hpoints = ["A_H_cons", "B_H_cons"]
   79      points = hpoints + [d+"_"+a for a in ("S", "G_half") for d in "AB"]
   80      roles = ["raw", "stage-cal", "first-cal"]
   81      contrasts = [("H_cons", "S"), ("H_cons", "G_half")]
   82      assert set(manifest["points"]) == set(hpoints)
   83      assert manifest["initials"]["H_cons"] == baseline["baselines"]["H"]["initial_identity"]
   84      assert manifest["starts"]["H_cons"] == manifest["points"]["A_H_cons"]["continuity"]
   85      members = manifest["points"]["A_H_cons"]["memory_summary"]["members"]
   86      rows = [np.flatnonzero(np.array(col["domains"]) == d) for d in "AB"]
   87      assert list(map(len, rows)) == [20, 20] and len(set(col["group_ids"])) == 40
   88      columns = col["columns"]
   89      assert len(columns) == 22
   90      errors, scalar_checks, all_csv = [], 0, []
   91  
   92      def compare(actual, expected):
   93          nonlocal scalar_checks
   94          a, b = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float), np.asarray(expected, dtype=float)
   95          assert a.shape == b.shape and np.array_equal(np.isnan(a), np.isnan(b))
   96          assert not np.isinf(a).any() and not np.isinf(b).any()
   97          difference = float(np.max(np.abs(a[~np.isnan(a)] - b[~np.isnan(b)]))) if (~np.isnan(a)).any() else 0.0
   98          errors.append(difference)
   99          scalar_checks += a.size
  100          assert difference <= 1e-12, difference
  101  
  102      draws = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(20260930)).integers(20, size=(5000, 2, 20))
  103      frequencies = np.stack([np.stack([np.bincount(d, minlength=20) for d in draws[:, i]]) for i in range(2)])
  104  
  105      def audit_stats(values, target, domain_index, kind, point, role, domain):
  106          for j, metric in enumerate(columns):
  107              x, t = values[:, j], target[metric]
  108              missing = int(np.isnan(x).sum())
  109              if missing:
  110                  assert t["mean"] is None and t["conditional_95pct_interval"] is None
  111                  assert t["undefined_groups"] == missing and t["total_groups"] == 20
  112                  all_csv.append([kind, point, role, domain, metric, None, None, None])
  113              else:
  114                  estimates = frequencies[domain_index] @ x / 20
  115                  mean, bounds = x.mean(), np.percentile(estimates, [2.5, 97.5])
  116                  compare([mean, *bounds], [t["mean"], *t["conditional_95pct_interval"]])
  117                  all_csv.append([kind, point, role, domain, metric, mean, *bounds])
  118  
  119      matrices, absolute, classification = {}, {}, {}
  120      rank_columns = [i for i, k in enumerate(columns) if k not in {
  121          "brier", "log_loss", "precision", "recall", "f1", "specificity", "balanced_accuracy", "mcc"}]
  122      for point in points:
  123          if point in hpoints:
  124              p, origin, point_col = manifest["points"][point], evaluation, col
  125          else:
  126              old_root, old_col, old_manifest = old_runs[point[2:]]
  127              p, origin, point_col = old_manifest["points"][point], old_root/"evaluation", old_col
  128          assert p["full_restore_verified"] and p["inference_restore_verified"]
  129          assert p["adam_step"] == (288 if point.startswith("A_") else 576)
  130          assert p["memory_summary"]["members"] == members and p["memory_summary"]["seen"] == 48
  131          assert p["memory_summary"]["bytes"] <= 1048576
  132          if point in hpoints:
  133              assert p["training"] == policy["training"] and p["pooling"] == policy["pooling"]
  134          matrices[point], absolute[point], classification[point] = {}, {}, {}
  135          for role in roles:
  136              classification[point][role] = {}
  137              rec = point_col["points"][point][role]
  138              saved = read(verify(origin, rec["matrix"]))
  139              assert saved["columns"] == columns
  140              matrix = np.asarray(saved["values"], dtype=float)
  141              assert matrix.shape == (40, 22) and not np.isinf(matrix).any()
  142              matrices[point][role] = matrix
  143              queries = np.load(verify(origin, rec["queries"]), allow_pickle=False)
  144              assert queries.shape == (40, 28, 10)
  145              compare(queries.mean(1), matrix[:, 12:])
  146              target = reported["absolute"][point][role]
  147              for i, domain in enumerate("AB"):
  148                  audit_stats(matrix[rows[i]], target["by_domain"][domain], i, "absolute", point, role, domain)
  149              compare(matrix.mean(0), [target["macro_all"][k] for k in columns])
  150              counts = read(verify(origin, rec["counts"]))
  151              assert len(counts) == 40 and all(r["tp"]+r["fn"] == 20 and r["fp"]+r["tn"] == 358 for r in counts)
  152              for i, r in enumerate(counts):
  153                  tp, fp, fn, tn = (r[k] for k in ("tp", "fp", "fn", "tn"))
  154                  denom = (tp+fp)*(tp+fn)*(tn+fp)*(tn+fn)
  155                  rates = [tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else None, tp/20, 2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn), tn/358,
  156                           (tp/20+tn/358)/2, (tp*tn-fp*fn)/np.sqrt(denom) if denom else None]
  157                  compare(matrix[i, 6:12], rates)
  158              c = np.asarray([[r[k] for k in ("tp", "fp", "fn", "tn")] for r in counts], np.int64)
  159              for domain, selected in [("all", np.arange(40)), ("A", rows[0]), ("B", rows[1])]:
  160                  tp, fp, fn, tn = map(int, c[selected].sum(0))
  161                  values = dict(tp=tp, fp=fp, fn=fn, tn=tn, fpr=fp/(fp+tn), recall=tp/(tp+fn),
  162                                precision=tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else None, f1=2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn))
  163                  for key, value in values.items():
  164                      compare(value, target["fixed_half_classification"][domain][key])
  165                  classification[point][role][domain] = values
  166              if point in hpoints:
  167                  scores = np.load(verify(run, p["scores"][role]), allow_pickle=False)
  168                  assert scores.shape == (40, 378) and np.isfinite(scores).all()
  169                  if role == "raw":
  170                      raw = scores
  171                      for suffix in ("raw", "calibration"):
  172                          original = np.load(verify(run, p["scores"][suffix]), allow_pickle=False)
  173                          for prefix in ("full", "inference"):
  174                              assert np.array_equal(original, np.load(verify(run, p["scores"][prefix+"-"+suffix]), allow_pickle=False))
  175                  else:
  176                      affine = p["maps"]["stage" if role == "stage-cal" else "first"]
  177                      compare(scores, affine["a"] * raw.astype(np.float64) + affine["b"])
  178                      assert np.array_equal(np.argsort(raw, axis=1, kind="stable"), np.argsort(scores, axis=1, kind="stable"))
  179                      compare(matrix[:, rank_columns], matrices[point]["raw"][:, rank_columns])
  180              absolute[point][role] = {d: {k: target["by_domain"][d][k]["mean"] for k in columns} for d in "AB"}
  181          if point in hpoints:
  182              mapping = read(verify(run, p["mapping"]))
  183              assert mapping["status"] == "PASS_CALIBRATION_FIT" and mapping["optimizer_success"] and mapping["a"] > 0
  184  
  185      paired_groups = {}
  186      for candidate, other in contrasts:
  187          contrast = candidate+"-"+other
  188          paired_groups[contrast] = {}
  189          for role in roles:
  190              for stage, report_key, kind in [("B", "comparisons", "final_contrast"), ("A", "initial_comparisons", "initial_contrast")]:
  191                  delta = matrices[stage+"_"+candidate][role] - matrices[stage+"_"+other][role]
  192                  for i, domain in enumerate("AB"):
  193                      audit_stats(delta[rows[i]], reported[report_key][contrast][role][domain], i, kind, contrast, role, domain)
  194                      if stage == "B" and role == "raw":
  195                          v = delta[rows[i], columns.index("map")]
  196                          paired_groups[contrast][domain] = dict(positive=int((v > 0).sum()), negative=int((v < 0).sum()), zero=int((v == 0).sum()), values=v.tolist())
  197              delta = (matrices["A_"+candidate][role]-matrices["B_"+candidate][role]) - (matrices["A_"+other][role]-matrices["B_"+other][role])
  198              delta *= np.array([-1. if k in ("brier", "log_loss") else 1. for k in columns])
  199              audit_stats(delta[rows[0]], reported["forgetting_comparisons"][contrast][role], 0, "forgetting_contrast", contrast, role, "A")
  200      for arm in ("H_cons", "S", "G_half"):
  201          for role in roles:
  202              delta = matrices["B_"+arm][role] - matrices["A_"+arm][role]
  203              audit_stats(delta[rows[0]], reported["old_changes"][arm][role], 0, "old_change", arm, role, "A")
  204  
  205      training = {p: read(verify(run, manifest["training"][p])) for p in hpoints}
  206      train_summary = {}
  207      for point, t in training.items():
  208          assert t["updates"] == 288 and [r["step"] for r in t["rows"]] == list(range(1, 289))
  209          if point.startswith("B_"):
  210              for key in ("members", "seen", "tables", "origins"):
  211                  assert t["memory_before"][key] == t["memory_after"][key]
  212              history = [r["history"] for r in t["rows"]]
  213              train_summary[point] = {"nonzero_distillation_steps": sum(r["distillation"] > 0 for r in history),
  214                  "mean_distillation": float(np.mean([r["distillation"] for r in history])),
  215                  "mean_current_supervised": float(np.mean([r["current"]["supervised"] for r in t["rows"]])),
  216                  "mean_history_supervised": float(np.mean([r["supervised"] for r in history]))}
  217          components = {}
  218          for role, weight in (("current", 1.), ("history", .1)):
  219              if role == "history" and point.startswith("A_"):
  220                  continue
  221              values = [r[role] for r in t["rows"]]
  222              components[role] = {"mean_JS": float(np.mean([r["consistency"] for r in values])),
  223                  "min_JS": float(min(r["consistency"] for r in values)),
  224                  "max_JS": float(max(r["consistency"] for r in values)),
  225                  "nonzero_JS_steps": sum(r["consistency"] != 0 for r in values),
  226                  "mean_weighted_JS": float(np.mean([r["consistency_contribution"] for r in values])),
  227                  "mean_supervised_contribution": float(np.mean([r["supervised_contribution"] for r in values])),
  228                  "mean_teacher_contribution": float(np.mean([r["teacher_contribution"] for r in values]))}
  229          train_summary.setdefault(point, {})["components"] = components
  230          for row in t["rows"]:
  231              total = 0.
  232              assert row["training"] == policy["training"] and row["pooling"] == policy["pooling"]
  233              for role, weight in (("current", 1.), ("history", .1)):
  234                  if role == "history" and point.startswith("A_"):
  235                      assert "history" not in row
  236                      continue
  237                  r = row[role]
  238                  assert r["qualification_without_c"] is False and r["mse1"] is None
  239                  assert np.isfinite(r["consistency"]) and r["record_gradient_norm"] > 0
  240                  if role == "current":
  241                      assert r["mse0"] == 0
  242                  expected = [weight*r["supervised"], weight*r["consistency"], .5*r["mse0"]]
  243                  actual = [r[k] for k in ("supervised_contribution", "consistency_contribution", "teacher_contribution")]
  244                  np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-6)
  245                  np.testing.assert_allclose(r["weighted"], sum(expected), rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-6)
  246                  np.testing.assert_allclose(r["distillation"], r["mse0"], rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-6)
  247                  total += sum(expected)
  248              np.testing.assert_allclose(row["total"], total, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-6)
  249          assert t["rows"][-1]["encoder_lr"] == 0 and t["rows"][-1]["head_lr"] == .001
  250      for stage in "AB":
  251          def trace(t):
  252              return (t["current_ids"], t["history_ids"], [[r["step"], r["encoder_lr"], r["head_lr"], r["current"]["assignment_sha256"], r.get("history",{}).get("assignment_sha256")] for r in t["rows"]])
  253          current = trace(training[stage+"_H_cons"])
  254          for other in ("S", "G_half"):
  255              old_root = old_runs[other][0]
  256              assert current == trace(read(old_root/"run/updates"/(stage+"_"+other+".json")))
  257      assert reported["success"]["passed"] == all(reported["comparisons"]["H_cons-S"]["raw"][d]["map"]["conditional_95pct_interval"][0] > 0 for d in "AB")
  258      assert reported["success"]["direct_H_new_B_positive"] == (reported["comparisons"]["H_cons-G_half"]["raw"]["B"]["map"]["conditional_95pct_interval"][0] > 0)
  259  
  260      independent_decisions, diagnostic_summary = {}, {}
  261      overfit = read(root / "diagnostics_evaluation/overfitting.json")
  262      curves, residuals, diagnostic_draws = {}, {}, {}
  263      for point in hpoints:
  264          captures = [read(verify(run / "diagnostics", r)) for r in manifest["diagnostics"][point]]
  265          assert [d["epoch"] for d in captures] == list(range(1, 7))
  266          residuals[point] = []
  267          fits, caches, valid_metrics = [], [], []
  268          for d in captures:
  269              assert d["valid_labels_used"] is False and d["valid_ids"] == col["group_ids"]
  270              fits.append(np.load(verify(run / "diagnostics", d["fit"]), allow_pickle=False))
  271              caches.append(np.load(verify(run / "diagnostics", d["cache"]), allow_pickle=False))
  272              rec = overfit["group_metrics"][f"{point}_epoch{d['epoch']}"]
  273              valid_metrics.append(np.load(verify(root / "diagnostics_evaluation", rec), allow_pickle=False))
  274              es = d["teacher_errors"]
  275              if es:
  276                  keys = [k for k, v in es[0].items() if k != "uid" and isinstance(v, (int, float))]
  277                  residuals[point].append({"epoch": d["epoch"], **{k: float(np.mean([r[k] for r in es])) for k in keys}})
  278          for i, domain in enumerate("AB"):
  279              curves.setdefault(point, {})[domain] = np.stack(valid_metrics)[:, rows[i]].mean(1).tolist()
  280          subset = [columns.index(k) for k in ("map", "recall_at_5", "log_loss")]
  281          compare(valid_metrics[-1], matrices[point]["raw"][:, subset])
  282          last_scores = np.load(verify(run / "diagnostics", captures[-1]["valid_blind"]), allow_pickle=False)
  283          endpoint_scores = np.load(run / manifest["points"][point]["scores"]["raw"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
  284          assert np.array_equal(last_scores, endpoint_scores)
  285          stage = 1 if point.startswith("A_") else 2
  286          for role, data, domain in [("fit", np.stack(fits), "A" if stage == 1 else "B"), ("cache", np.stack(caches), "A")]:
  287              if data.shape[1] == 0:
  288                  continue
  289              key = (stage, role, domain)
  290              if key not in diagnostic_draws:
  291                  payload = (json.dumps([20260930, "ABC", stage, role, domain, "diagnostics"], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
  292                  seed = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()[:8], "big") % (2**63-1)
  293                  generator = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(seed))
  294                  diagnostic_draws[key] = (generator.integers(data.shape[1], size=(5000, data.shape[1])), generator.integers(20, size=(5000, 20)))
  295              td, vd = diagnostic_draws[key]
  296              v = np.stack(valid_metrics)[:, rows[0 if domain == "A" else 1]]
  297              signs = np.array([1., 1., -1.])
  298              target = overfit["points"][point][role][domain]
  299              compare(data.mean(1), target["train_raw_curve"])
  300              compare(v.mean(1), target["valid_raw_curve"])
  301              tb = (data[-1]-data[0])*signs
  302              vb = (v[-1]-v[0])*signs
  303              for values, draw, field in [(tb, td, "epoch1_to_6_train_benefit"), (vb, vd, "epoch1_to_6_valid_benefit")]:
  304                  compare(values.mean(0), target[field]["mean"])
  305                  compare(np.percentile(values[draw].mean(1), [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).T, target[field]["conditional_95pct_interval"])
  306              gap_draws = (data[:, td].mean(2)-v[:, vd].mean(2))*signs
  307              compare(np.percentile(gap_draws[-1]-gap_draws[0], [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).T, target["epoch1_to_6_gap_widening"]["conditional_95pct_interval"])
  308              gap = (data.mean(1)-v.mean(1))*signs
  309              gap_change = gap[-1]-gap[0]
  310              gap_ci = np.percentile(gap_draws[-1]-gap_draws[0], [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).T
  311              train_ci = np.percentile(tb[td].mean(1), [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).T
  312              valid_ci = np.percentile(vb[vd].mean(1), [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).T
  313              compare(gap, target["benefit_gap_curve"])
  314              compare(gap_change, target["epoch1_to_6_gap_widening"]["mean"])
  315              compare(np.percentile(gap_draws,[2.5,97.5],axis=1).transpose(1,2,0),target["benefit_gap_conditional_intervals"])
  316              decisions = {}
  317              for k, metric in enumerate(("map", "recall_at_5", "log_loss")):
  318                  point_signal = tb[:,k].mean() > 0 and vb[:,k].mean() < 0 and gap_change[k] > 0
  319                  supported = train_ci[k,0] > 0 and valid_ci[k,1] < 0 and gap_ci[k,0] > 0
  320                  decisions[metric] = "有相应迹象" if supported else "证据不足" if point_signal else "未见明确迹象"
  321              assert decisions == target["interpretation"]
  322              independent_decisions.setdefault(point,{})[role] = {domain:decisions}
  323              diagnostic_summary.setdefault(point,{})[role] = {"domain":domain,"train_benefit":tb.mean(0).tolist(),"valid_benefit":vb.mean(0).tolist(),"gap_widening":gap_change.tolist(),"gap_interval":gap_ci.tolist(),"interpretation":decisions}
  324  
  325  
  326      with (args.output / "all_metrics.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
  327          writer = csv.writer(f)
  328          writer.writerow(["kind", "point_or_contrast", "role", "domain", "metric", "mean", "lower_95", "upper_95"])
  329          writer.writerows(all_csv)
  330      summary = dict(absolute=absolute, classification=classification, paired_map_groups=paired_groups,
  331                     training=train_summary, diagnostic_summary=diagnostic_summary, valid_curves=curves,
  332                     residuals=residuals, overfit_interpretations=independent_decisions,
  333                     success=reported["success"], baseline_files=52, forgetting_sign="High-good A-B; Brier/log-loss B-A; candidate minus other")
  334      write(args.output / "summary.json", summary)
  335      import matplotlib
  336      matplotlib.use("Agg")
  337      import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
  338      plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
  339      colors = {"H_cons-S":"#405f86", "H_cons-G_half":"#309687"}
  340      fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11,7.5), constrained_layout=True)
  341      for i, domain in enumerate("AB"):
  342          ax = axes[0,i]
  343          for j, contrast in enumerate(("H_cons-S","H_cons-G_half")):
  344              r = reported["comparisons"][contrast]["raw"][domain]["map"]
  345              lo,hi=r["conditional_95pct_interval"]
  346              ax.errorbar(r["mean"],j,xerr=[[r["mean"]-lo],[hi-r["mean"]]],fmt="o",capsize=5,color=colors[contrast])
  347          ax.axvline(0,color="#999999",linewidth=1)
  348          ax.set_yticks(range(2),["H_cons - S","H_cons - H"])
  349          ax.set_title(("Old domain A" if i==0 else "New domain B")+": final MAP difference")
  350          ax.set_xlabel("Paired mean and conditional 95% interval")
  351          ax=axes[1,i]
  352          target=overfit["points"]["B_H_cons"]["cache" if domain=="A" else "fit"][domain]
  353          ax.plot(range(1,7),[r[0] for r in target["train_raw_curve"]],"o-",label="H_cons cache A" if domain=="A" else "H_cons fit B",color="#cf5c37")
  354          ax.plot(range(1,7),[r[0] for r in target["valid_raw_curve"]],"o-",label="H_cons development "+domain,color="#405f86")
  355          ax.set_title("During B training: "+domain+" MAP")
  356          ax.set_xlabel("Epoch");ax.set_ylabel("MAP");ax.legend()
  357      fig.suptitle("H_cons: one fixed seed, A to B, reused development groups")
  358      fig.savefig(args.output / "comparison.png", dpi=180)
  359      fig.savefig(args.output / "comparison.pdf")
  360      plt.close(fig)
  361      audit = dict(status="PASS_SAVED_RESULT_AUDIT", python=platform.python_version(), observed_epoch=time.time(),
  362                   elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started, source_count=44,
  363                   checked_files=len(set(checked_files)), scalar_checks=scalar_checks,
  364                   maximum_absolute_difference=max(errors), statistics_rows=len(all_csv),
  365                   diagnostics=12, diagnostic_decisions=9, updates=576,
  366                   baseline_files=52, success=reported["success"],
  367                   limits="Saved matrices/counts/queries/scores only; no labels/model/Memory loads. Reconstructs fixed registered bootstrap, not additional resampling choices. AP/ROC/Brier/log-loss not regenerated from unavailable labels. Qualification evidence reused; no new scientific candidate.")
  368      write(args.output / "audit.json", audit)
  369      print(json.dumps(audit))
